previous_admission_summary.summary_paragraph: A man with end-stage renal disease on peritoneal dialysis was admitted for shortness of breath and fluid overload. He had gained weight and was unable to lie flat due to orthopnea. Initial peritoneal dialysis provided no relief, so he underwent hemodialysis, which removed 4 liters of fluid and significantly improved his symptoms. His hyperkalemia resolved with treatment, and peritoneal fluid analysis showed no infection. The peritoneal catheter was in the correct position, but due to ongoing difficulties, the decision was made to transition to hemodialysis temporarily. His prolonged QT interval prompted discontinuation of trazodone. He was discharged home in stable condition with follow-up arranged for dialysis and medication management.

productive cough, shortness of breath, and sore throat.

# Influenza-like illness: Patient presented with 6 days of ILI. 
Given multiple comorbities and patient/his wife's concern for 
worsening of symptoms, he was started empirically on Tamiflu 
75mg daily (___) and admitted for observation. He was stable 
overnight and influenza DFA came back negative, so Tamiflu was 
discontinued. He received supportive care for his upper 
respirtory viral infection with dextromethorphan/guaifenesin, 
cepacol lozenges, and acetaminophen. Reports slight improvement 
in his symptoms. Two sets of blood cultures were pending at time 
of discharge.

# ESRD on HD: On HD ___. Last session was ___. 
Creatinine remained below baseline. He continued sevelamer and 
nephrocaps.

# DM2:  Initially hyperglycemic to 300s, likely in the context 
of stress response to infection. He received lantus 15u with 
breakfast and a humalog sliding scale at home.

# Anemia: Patient has chronic anemia, currently macrocytic. 
Likely related to chronic kidney disease and anemia of chronic 
inflammation. Guaiac negative in the ED. Denies any black or 
bloody stools. B12 and folate were within normal limits.

# HTN: Continued lisinopril, carvedilol, Imdur.

# CHF: Patient was euvolemic. Continued aspirin, carvedilol, 
lisinopril, Imdur.

# DVT Prophylaxis: Patient received heparin products during this 
admission.

# Code status: Patient was confirmed full code during this 
admission.
